title: Betwixt
summary: BETWIXT', preposition 1. Between; in the space that separates two persons or things; as, betwixt two oaks. 2. Passing between; from one to another, noting intercourse. [See Between.]

inlines.v: BETWIXT', preposition 1. Between; in the space that separates two persons or things; as, betwixt two oaks. 2. Passing between; from one to another, noting intercourse. [See Between.]
